title: Random and Time Modules
objectives: Use the import system to load modules
Generate random numbers with the random module
Create delays and measure time with the time module
description: Unlock Python's standard library with the random and time modules. Learn the import system, generate random numbers, and control time in your programs. Build games, reaction testers, and password generators!

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Random Integer
exercises.description: Generate a random integer between 1 and 10.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Time Delay
exercises.description: Import time module and create a 2-second delay.

exercises.title: Glitch Fix: Module Not Imported
exercises.description: Using random without importing it! Add the import statement.

exercises.title: Glitch Fix: Wrong Function Name
exercises.description: It's randint() not randomint()! Fix the function name.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Dice Roller
exercises.description: Import random and roll a six-sided die (1-6). Print the result.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Random Agent ID
exercises.description: Generate a random agent ID between 1000-9999. Print it.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Coin Flip
exercises.description: Use random.choice() to pick 'Heads' or 'Tails' from a list. Print result.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Randomized Decoy Selection
exercises.description: Your extraction team needs a random escape route. Type code that selects one decoy path from options A, B, or C.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Reproducible Intel Generator
exercises.description: For testing your spy gadget firmware, you need reproducible 'random' numbers. Type professional code using seed(42) to ensure consistent results during QA.
exercises.targetCode:
import random
# Set seed for consistent results
random.seed(42)
result = random.randint(1, 100)
print('Generated:', result)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Wrong Module Import
exercises.description: SYSTEM ERROR: Your randomization chip isn't working! You imported the wrong module. Time module doesn't have randint - you need the random module!

exercises.title: Mission Budget: Random Resource Allocation
exercises.description: HQ allocated 5 random supply drops (1-10 units each). Calculate total resources available for your operation.
exercises.starterCode:
import random
# Sum 5 random supply drops
exercises.solution:
import random
total = 0
for i in range(5):
    total += random.randint(1, 10)
print(total)

exercises.title: Encryption: Random Passcode Generator
exercises.description: Generate a 4-character secure passcode for mission briefcase. Use random capital letters (A-Z) only. One random char at a time!
exercises.starterCode:
import random
# Generate 4-char encryption key
letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
exercises.solution:
import random
letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
password = ''
for i in range(4):
    password += random.choice(letters)
print(password)

exercises.title: Undercover Ops: Lottery Cover Identity
exercises.description: You're posing as a lottery player for surveillance. Generate 6 unique 'lucky' numbers  (1-49) using random.sample(). Print each on separate line to look authentic.
exercises.starterCode:
import random
# Generate believable lottery numbers
exercises.solution:
import random
numbers = random.sample(range(1, 50), 6)
for num in numbers:
    print(num)

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Card Game Deception
exercises.description: CASINO INFILTRATION: You're counting cards at enemy casino. Shuffle a 4-card hand (['A', 'K', 'Q', 'J']) using random.shuffle() to avoid detection, then reveal each card sequentially. One wrong move blows your cover!
exercises.starterCode:
import random
# Shuffle and reveal cards naturally
deck = ['A', 'K', 'Q', 'J']
exercises.solution:
import random
deck = ['A', 'K', 'Q', 'J']
random.shuffle(deck)
for card in deck:
    print(card)
